websiteNote: From 5 pages of their campaign website, including its issues section.

Jobs and the economy.summary: Says that as lieutenant governor they worked to grow jobs by seeking economic development.
Jobs and the economy.quote: From 2015-2023, he served as the state’s 20th lieutenant and focused on growing jobs through aggressively pursuing economic development, more parental choice in education and boldly reforming state government.

Taxes and spending.summary: Says that in Congress they pushed for changes to taxes and entitlement programs to grow jobs and lower the national debt.
Taxes and spending.quote: In Congress, he advocated for bold tax reform and entitlement reform to grow jobs and reduce the national debt.

Public safety.summary: Says violent offenders in Arkansas are let out on parole after serving only part of their sentences.
Public safety.quote: Arkansas has a deceptive and dangerous parole problem where violent felons go free after serving only a fraction of their time.

Health care.summary: Says people who commit Medicaid fraud will face serious penalties.
Health care.quote: Individuals who submit false claims, misuse Medicaid funds, or exploit programs intended to serve vulnerable Arkansans will face significant consequences.

Schools and education.summary: Says the state can move ahead with plans for higher teacher pay, maternity leave, and safer schools under the LEARNS law.
Schools and education.quote: And the Arkansas Department of Education can immediately resume planning to provide teachers higher salaries and maternity leave, make schools safer for our children, and enable the most vulnerable children to obtain the education they deserve.

Elections and government.summary: Says the voting process and voting machines used in Arkansas follow state law.
Elections and government.quote: The voting process and machines used in Arkansas comply with state law.

Roads and infrastructure.summary: Says the state should use more of its general revenue to pay for highways.
Roads and infrastructure.quote: I want to see general revenue play a bigger role.

Immigration.summary: Says they will keep working to secure the nation's borders.
Immigration.quote: I will continue to fight to secure America’s borders, even if President Biden’s administration won’t.
